_readme: HOW TO ADD PHOTOS AND VIDEOS:
1. Put the file in photos/<year>/  (e.g. photos/2019/draft-night.jpg or celebration.mp4).
2. Add the file name to that year's list below. Caption is optional.
3. Commit and push. The gallery picks it up automatically.
iPhone .mov files should be converted to .mp4 - Chrome and Android often cannot play .mov.
Keep videos under ~50 MB; GitHub warns above that and hard-blocks at 100 MB.
Videos may optionally have a poster image: {"file": "clip.mp4", "poster": "clip-thumb.jpg"}
